paragraphs: Rabbi Bata reported Rabbi Yochanan (see above, Baha). Rabbi Abba said to Bata, “Do you and Ulla disagree?” Rabbi Yitzchak said to him, “Bata from here and from there”—meaning, from Babylonia and from the Land of Israel: Temurah 29a (cited here as chapter Mitzvat Chalitzah). Perhaps this is Bata bar Kahana (I did not find Bata bar Kahana).
